text: I gave an invited talk in [Nikolaus Kriegeskorte's lab](https://kriegeskortelab.zuckermaninstitute.columbia.edu/) at the Zuckerman Mind Brain Behavior Institute, Columbia University!
I defended my PhD thesis *summa cum laude*!
I started as a postdoctoral researcher in the [Machine Learning Group](https://web.ml.tu-berlin.de/) at TU Berlin!
Our paper [Characterizing universal object representations across vision models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13675) was accepted to NeurIPS 2026!
New preprint on [Similarity-based representation factorization for revealing interpretable dimensions in representational data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26921) available on arXiv!
New preprint on [Characterizing universal object representations across vision models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13675) available on arXiv!
Our paper [Dimensions underlying the representational alignment of deep neural networks with humans](https://www.nature.com/articles/s42256-025-01041-7) was published in Nature Machine Intelligence!

Our paper [Ten principles for reliable, efficient, and adaptable coding in psychology and cognitive neuroscience](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44271-025-00236-3) was published in Communications Psychology!
